Headline: Everything in view. No rush.
Subtitle: A brief notification when Claude needs your attention.
EmptyHint: Open a conversation or send a message to get started.
AutoDismissHelp: The notification closes itself. Return when it suits you.
AcknowledgeHint: Stop reminders for the selected session
IntegrationRemoved: Integration disabled. Other hooks were preserved.
IntegrationAdded: Integration enabled. Open a new Claude Code conversation in VS Code to get started.
ConfigWriteError: Could not update Claude settings. Check file access and try again.
HooksInvalid: The existing hooks field is not an object. No changes were made.
EventInvalid: The existing {0} event is not a list.
ConfigChanged: Settings changed during installation. Please try again.
EventAccessError: Cannot access the events folder. Restart using your Windows account.
TestWhilePaused: Resume notifications to test the alert.
TestPopupDisabled: Enable the 3-second notification to preview it.
CodeNotRunning: Open VS Code to access your Claude Code conversation.
CodeOpenError: Could not open VS Code. Open it from the taskbar.
StatusError: Claude stopped due to an error
QueueSubtitle: Pending requests first. At your own pace.
PendingHelp: Deferring keeps the request pending. Confirmed responses and ended sessions leave the queue; records expire after 24 h.
DeferredMinutes: Deferred for {0} minutes. The request remains pending.
ProfileHelp: Choose which events may interrupt you.
SummaryCounts:
{0} request(s) awaiting action.
{1} response(s) completed without an alert.
{2} error interruption(s) without an alert.
SummaryHelp: Silenced events remain in local history. Silent mode blocks all alerts.
ResumedSummary: Normal mode resumed. See the summary in Rhythm.
ProjectRuleHelp: Alerts must also be allowed by the current profile. Other projects keep their own rules.
HealthOk: Executable, configuration and queue writes checked. A new Claude event confirms the full flow.
HealthConfigMissing: Queue is writable. Enable or refresh integration in Preferences, then open a new conversation.
HealthQueueError: Could not write to the local queue. Check your Windows account permissions.
ActivitySaveError: Could not save local activity. Current pending requests remain in the dashboard.
RestoreError: A local file could not be restored. A copy will be preserved before the next save.
ReminderLimit: Up to three reminders per request. Deferring resets this limit. Alerts always last three seconds.
